environment.browser: Google Chrome for Testing 131.0.6778.204, headless Linux
environment.camera: Synthetic canvas captureStream with real HTMLVideoElement playback; permission outcomes simulated

checksPassed: Late getUserMedia response after close is stopped before attaching to the detached preview
Denied permission shows retry; granted retry starts a live preview
Unsupported Permissions API query falls back to the native getUserMedia path
Known browser denial does not re-prompt; changed grant recovers on window focus
Rear-facing video preferred; microphone is never requested
Actual printed QR pixels decode through a real video element in lookup, courier shipping, and parcel-code assignment
Nine optical decode combinations: three purposes at 4, 8, and 16 pixels per QR module
Successful camera and manual completion occur once and stop every track
Unexpected decoder failure exposes retry and recovers
Camera-ended event exposes retry and recovers

baselineRegressions.latePermission: Original scanner failed the same browser assertion: one stream attached to a detached video after close; fixed source passed.
baselineRegressions.largeQr: Original ZXing optical detection failed at 8 and 16 pixels/module for both the application generator and the ZXing reference writer. Matrix decoding passed. Bounded smaller-frame retries read those frames.

fallbackBounds: Normal full-frame decode first; only QR frame misses trigger up to two retries. Reused canvases have long edges capped at 640 and 320 pixels; small frames are skipped.
otherValidation: Root verified fresh production build and all 151 tests
limitations: No physical Android, iPhone, or iPad camera was available for this web verification.
Synthetic browser permission responses verify application behavior, not each operating system permission dialog.
The web findings are separate from the native Android Google Play scanner failure.
